channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: Man gets 7 years for threatening OC judge in his child custody case
item.description: He appeared eager to be deported back to Mexico, nodding as the sentencing judge advised him that was a possibility. 'When it comes to my relationship with this country, it's over,' he said. "Goodbye, good riddance. We're done.'

item.title: Rams, tight end Tyler Higbee agree to 2-year deal
item.description: Re-signing Higbee, the longest-tenured player on the Rams’ roster, was among the team’s top priorities ahead of the start of free agency next week. The contract is reportedly worth up to $8 million deal.

item.title: Orange County scores and player stats for Thursday, March 5
item.description: Scores and stats from Orange County games on Thursday, March 5

item.title: Lakers’ Jake LaRavia shares defensive lessons from Marcus Smart
item.description: Former teammates on the Grizzlies, they continue to show off their respective skillsets and provide tenacious energy now that they have been reunited with the Lakers.

item.title: LeBron James breaks Kareem Abdul-Jabbar’s NBA record for career field goals
item.description: The Lakers star sets the mark with his third basket on Thursday night in Denver, giving him 15,838 for his career (regular season). James already owns the career scoring record and has topped 50,000 points including his postseason numbers.

item.title: Anže Kopitar reaches milestone as Kings top Islanders for 1st win under interim coach D.J. Smith
item.description: Artemi Panarin scores his first goal in a Kings uniform, Kopitar becomes the 25th player to skate in 1,500 NHL games, and they beat New York, 5-3, for just their second win since January.

item.title: LeBron James gets his record, but Lakers can’t catch short-handed Nuggets
item.description: James passes Kareem Abdul-Jabbar for the NBA’s career field goals mark, but the Lakers start slow and can’t complete a late rally in a 120-113 defeat to a Denver team playing without three key players.

item.title: UC Irvine men crush Cal Poly to secure spot in Big West Tournament semifinals
item.description: The Anteaters avenge an earlier loss to the Mustangs with a 107-85 home win that secures a top-two seed and a double-bye in next week’s eight-team tourney. UCI can clinch at least a share of the regular-season crown by beating UC Davis on Saturday.

item.title: Mater Dei boys basketball beats JSerra to continue surge in state playoffs
item.description: Mater Dei wins for the second time in the CIF State playoffs, setting up a game Saturday against St. John Bosco in the regional semifinals.

item.title: Ducks acquire defenseman John Carlson from Capitals
item.description: The consistent Carlson, 36, is enjoying one of the most productive seasons of his career (46 points in 55 games). The Ducks send a conditional first-round draft pick and a 2027 third-rounder to Washington.
